title: Moonlit Curse
description: She was born without a wolf, but the alpha’s mark awakens something ancient within her soul.

seasons.title: The Awakening
seasons.description: The discovery of the ancient mark.

parts.text:
The moon hung low and heavy in the sky, like a silver eye watching her every move from the depths of the midnight blue canvas. It was the night of the Great Awakening, the ceremony where every eighteen-year-old in the Blood Moon Pack was expected to finally shift and find their inner wolf.

Elara stood at the edge of the clearing, her heart hammering against her ribs like a trapped bird. While the others felt the first stirrings of their beast, she felt only the familiar, hollow silence that had haunted her since childhood. She was the Alpha's daughter, the one who was supposed to lead, yet she remained stubbornly, painfully human.

She felt the burn on her shoulder before she saw it—a searing heat that pulsed in time with the lunar cycle. It wasn't the dull ache of a shifting bone or the stretching of muscle. It was something sharper, more ancient, a fire that seemed to originate from the very core of her soul and radiate outward.

Dropping her cloak, she stared in the reflection of a nearby pool. A glowing crescent mark was blooming on her skin, silver and brilliant against the darkness. It wasn't a wolf's mark. It was the mark of the Lunar Oracle, a legend whispered by the elders to frighten children, a power that had been lost to the pack for a thousand years.

In the distance, a howl ripped through the silence, followed by the crashing of underbrush. The sound was closer than it should have been, filled with a primal urgency that sent ice water through her veins. He was coming for her—Kaelen, the rogue alpha who had been hunting the Oracle's line since the beginning of time.

She realized then that the ceremony was no longer about her wolf. It was about survival. The mark continued to pulse, its light growing so bright it illuminated the forest floor around her. Elara turned and ran, the whispers of the ancient ones beginning to echo in her mind, guiding her deeper into the shadows where the old magic still breathed.
